description: tether/errors.py defines the exception hierarchy rooted at TetherError; tether/cli.py's handle_errors decorator catches TetherError (the base) and maps it to a clean 'error: ...' message with exit code 1. Every user-facing failure must subclass TetherError or it escapes handle_errors as an uncaught traceback. Adding an error type meant to surface to the user requires it to inherit TetherError.
